why: Same objects: the project's sphere Milnor.Sphere.Sph n = sphG⁻¹{0} is the blind Metric.sphere 0 1 (equal sets via preimage_eq_sphere, not definitionally; rewriting under the binders suffices), and both use Mathlib's HomotopyGroup.Pi at arbitrary base points. A ⇒ B: corollary_22_3 (bijection, i ≤ 2n−2) and corollary_22_3_mulEquiv (group isomorphism, 1 ≤ i ≤ 2n−2) are exactly B's two clauses; conversely B gives back exactly these two conjuncts (B_to_A_common, #rt_check OK). B ⇒ A fails genuinely: A also contains the second half of Freudenthal (surjection / surjective homomorphism π_i Sⁿ → π_{i+1}Sⁿ⁺¹ for i = 2n−1), the Riemannian index estimate hidx_sph (non-minimal geodesics p → −p on Sⁿ⁺¹ have energy-Hessian index ≥ 2n) and hball_sph (compact closed Riemannian balls), none of which follows from B.
overlap: n/a (B_to_A not proved). A_to_B and B_to_A_common use only Milnor.Sphere.preimage_eq_sphere and the hypothesis.
embedded_special_case_note: B quantifies only over the concrete Euclidean spheres; no Riemannian manifold in B.
